problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}c \\ d\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the vector $\,x=[\begin{aligned}-6+7\text{i} \\ 1-6\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $ad+bc?$

feedback.problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}c \\ d\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the vector $\,x=[\begin{aligned}8+\text{i} \\ -5+3\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $ac-bd?$
feedback.worked_solution:
For the given vector $\,x=[\begin{aligned}3-5\text{i} \\ 6-3\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =[\begin{aligned}8+\text{i} \\ -5+3\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(x)}+\text{i}\,{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(x)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore $\,a=8,b=-5,c=1$ and $d=3$, which implies that 

$$
ac-bd=8\cdot 1-(-5)\cdot 3=23.
$$
